papers.title: MPIE-Bench: Benchmarking Anatomically Plausible Multi-Person Interaction Editing
papers.abstract: Text-to-image and personalized editing models synthesize high-fidelity single-subject images with ease. Yet placing multiple named people into shared contact actions exposes major failures: fused limbs, invented extremities, and interpenetrating bodies.

papers.title: Beyond Borrowed Histories: Person-Aligned User Simulation for Interactive Role-Playing Evaluation
papers.abstract: Role-playing agents have become one of the most important consumer applications of large language models. Users engage in multi-turn conversations for experiences such as emotional comfort, making reliable evaluation essential.

papers.title: See2Think: Do Multimodal Models Really Use Intermediate Visual States?
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models increasingly use sketches, annotations, tools, and intermediate images during reasoning, but it remains unclear whether they truly rely on these visual states.

papers.title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations from a Video and Its Shadow
papers.abstract: A novel approach to any-action, frame-level control of interactive video world models. Shadow pairs replay the same dynamics under independently resampled appearance, enabling precise control across diverse dynamics.

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Execute Parent Orders?
papers.abstract: First systematic study of large language models for parent-order execution in algorithmic trading. PACE framework decomposes execution into long-horizon planning and short-horizon execution without explicit market assumptions.

papers.title: Sigma-Mem: An Online Reliability Memory for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: An online reliability memory that records historical competence evidence for individual peers and peer relationship evidence across peer sets in multi-agent systems without retraining underlying models.

papers.title: INTACT: Isomorphic Intent-to-Action Learning for Search-Free World Models
papers.abstract: End-to-end JEPA that turns action-labeled, reward-free trajectories into a deployable intent-to-action interface. Supports robust distributional action law without pointwise latent matching or globally linear dynamics.

papers.title: Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation
papers.abstract: New paradigm that factors the training loop by exploring K candidate matches between model generations and data, and training on the best. Establishes exploration as a pretraining axis for generative models.

papers.title: LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger
papers.abstract: Treats multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine. Tool outputs normalize into a Structured Evidence Ledger serving as trajectory state with grounding checked at entity and numeric level.

papers.title: Multi-Head Attention Residuals
papers.abstract: Introduces Multi-Head Attention Residuals where routing query reshapes into H per-subspace heads, each with its own softmax over depth history. Improves validation loss across 100M to 1B parameter scales.

cc_updates.body: Added Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5), now the default Opus model — 1M context, fast mode at $10/$50 per Mtok. Added sandbox.network.strictAllowlist setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting. Added DirectoryAdded hook that fires after /add-dir or the SDK register_repo_root control request registers a new working directory mid-session. Added mcp_server_errors to the headless stream-json init event. Added workflowSizeGuideline settings key. Added nested subagent forwarding in stream-json. Fixed claude -p text output dropping the answer already produced when a turn dies on a mid-stream API error.

Changed /code-review to run as a background subagent. Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text for word and line deletions in --ax-screen-reader mode. Fixed Windows paths with \u-prefixed segments being corrupted into CJK characters in tool inputs. Fixed the left arrow key discarding the conversation with no undo. Added HTTP status and error text to claude mcp list and /mcp when a server fails to connect. Fixed multi-line paste collapsing into one line with j in place of newlines.
